title: Launch the second vault
intro: Pays the IdentityMD swarm 0.5 IMD on Robinhood Chain to audit, adapt, test and deploy PinkyVaultV2. Two transactions, both signed in your wallet.
expectedLabel: launch.open@launch-1, contracts only (evm_contracts), PinkyVaultV2 from commit 778eeaa, owner 0x89d6…f8ef
stepAsk: Order the launch. The Intake pulls the 0.5 IMD and the swarm starts.
body: {"objective":"Launch PinkyVaultV2 from this repository on Robinhood Chain as contracts only: no token and no pool. Deploy PinkyVaultV2 with the constructor arguments in launch.json. It is Pinky's second vault, beside the live PinkyVault, and reuses the live PINKY token and PinkyStaking from launch #1166. A holder bonds IMD behind one of four promises about their own wallet (Keep, Pay, Hold, Moves), optionally made to a beneficiary; after the term settle buys the IdentityMD oracle's answer through Intake version 2 with requestWithFailure, paid from the bond, and payout pays the bond on the verdict, with a 1% fee to PinkyStaking on bonds that go home or to a beneficiary. The owner's settings change only through proposals applied after seven days.
